description.intro: The Nike Brasil Dri-FIT Academy Pro Children's sweatshirt is designed to allow young footballers to train with comfort and style inspired by the Brazilian team. Its blue design reflects the modern identity of the Canarinha.
key_benefits: Nike Dri-FIT technology: Remove sweat from the skin to maintain breathability and comfort.
Design Academy Pro: Inspired by the garments used in academies and professional teams.
Orificios para los pulgares: Permiten ampliar la cobertura y mantener las mangas en su sitio.
Lightweight and flexible fabric: Promotes freedom of movement during training.
